messages:
Lina S: @sam_dealdesk quick one — PocketBook (YC S21) asked for a POC. They want a 6-week trial with prioritized capacity and a promo credit bundle. Asking for help to get deal-desk signoff

sam_dealdesk: Got it. What exactly are they requesting in numbers? Any expected commit or is it purely trial? Any security asks?

Lina S: Their ask: 120k token credits for generation + 50k tokens for embedding evaluation. Priority GPU queue for first 2 weeks for load testing. No long-term commit up front, but they said likely convert to a Dedicated plan if perf looks good. Also asked about SOC2 certs and data retention options.

mike_finance: 120k gen + 50k embed ~ estimated hosted cost $3.2k at list. Full approval depends on whether they sign a PoC MSA that limits abuse and includes a convert/feedback clause. If no contract, we usually cap credits to $1k-$2k.

jess_engineer: We can carve out a small dedicated queue for their POC for ~2 weeks; ops will need the start date to schedule. For load tests, recommend keeping sequence length limited to 1k to avoid outliers.

Lina S: Proposed middle ground — Offer a "POC Promo Bundle": 80k gen + 30k embed credits (total ~$2k list) + 2 weeks priority queue. Add a 30-day post-trial discounted rate (20% off) if they sign a 3-month convert commit within 30 days. Would that be approvable?

sam_dealdesk: That sounds reasonable as a provisional offer. Need finance + legal OK on conversion language. Also require they complete the standard Startup/Security questionnaire before we enable priority infra.

tara_legal: Will review the PoC MSA language. Key asks: (1) limit PII ingestion, (2) define scope of credits and expiry; (3) add a clause that credits are not refundable and convert-to-paid terms are optional (customer opt-in). If they want SSO/SCIM we need a short SOW.

mike_finance: If you include a 3-month $2k/mo convert commit clause, finance can justify approving the 80k/30k bundle. If no commit, approve only 20k gen + 10k embed as one-off.

Lina S: Ok I'll push the 3-month convert option in the draft and ask them to sign the PoC MSA. If they refuse commit, we'll offer the smaller one-off bundle.

ops_bot: [deploy-scheduler] Priority queue slot blocked for PocketBook tentative window: Mon 2026-05-04 -> Fri 2026-05-15. Confirm to finalize.

jess_engineer: Confirmed, that window works from engineering side. Ops will need the contact + expected concurrency numbers.

Lina S: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the PoC MSA with the conversion clause and security checklist, send to @tara_legal and @mike_finance for final signoff, then share with the customer. Target: get signatures and enable credits by next Monday. :thumbsup:

sam_dealdesk: Provisional deal-desk approval granted for the 80k/30k bundle contingent on signed PoC MSA with conversion clause and completed security questionnaire.

mike_finance: Finance acknowledges provisional approval. Final release of credits upon signed MSA.

Lina S: Awesome — will update thread with the signed copy.
